newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse session strongly ahead.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse session strongly ahead.

text.p: 1245 GMT - German shares end lively bourse session over 1.5 percent higher, lifted by the dollar recovery to 1.675 marks and overnight gains on Wall Street. Firm debt market also underpins trade, but traders see little chance of move over 3,300 points in the near term.
* DAX-30 index ends at 3,233.21 points, up 49 points.
* March DAX DTB future at 3,244 points, up 51.
* Allianz higher but off earlier highs after its domestic non-life insurance unit reported a 41.5 percent rise in 1996 profit and gave positive outlook for 1997 profit.
* Banks and chemical stocks among top volumes.
